name: Are motion-sensor kitchen lights worth installing, or will they turn off while I’m cooking?

mainEntity.name: Are motion-sensor kitchen lights worth installing, or will they turn off while I’m cooking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Motion sensors can be convenient for pantry, sink, or utility areas, but they are not always ideal as the only control for the entire kitchen. False activation, delayed shutoff, line-of-sight issues, and difficulty keeping lights on during extended tasks can be frustrating. Elite Remodeling & Design can consider sensor placement as part of the room’s control plan. Decide whether the sensor supplements a wall switch or replaces it. Test the response while carrying groceries, cooking, and sitting at the island. Keep manual control available where the kitchen serves several activities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sensors can work well in pantries and utility zones, but whole-kitchen sensors may cause false triggers or unwanted shutoff. Use them as a supplement where appropriate, retain manual control, and test the response during cooking, cleanup, and seated activities.
